newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy IRI names global coordinators for Autostrade.
newsitem.headline: Italy IRI names global coordinators for Autostrade.

text.p: Italian state holding company IRI on Wednesday named Banca Commericale Italiana and SBC Warburg as the joint global coordinators for the privatisation of the motorway operator Autostrade.
The Italian government intends to proceed with the reduction of IRI's control of Autostrade by the summer.

Banca Commerciale Italiana (BCI) will lead the placement of shares in Italy for the public share offer, and will be assisted by San Paolo di Torino in the role of joint-lead manager. SBC Warburg will coordinate the international placement of shares.
The IRI statement said that the global coordinators will not be involved in the formation of a group of stable shareholders, which it said would be a matter for IRI and the Italian Treasury.
